name: core
description: Always-on working discipline for every project: report status and ETA for long-running tasks when they finish, fail, or stall, and tag each project with its categories so domain plugins such as research load only where they belong, put every web service a machine hosts behind one token-gated entry point, keep a shareable per-user GPU niceness counter for the shared behemoth box, and chart every model call of the local coding agents like a stock.

interface.shortDescription: Progress updates, project tags, service hub, usage charts
interface.longDescription: Skills that belong in every project. Watch transfers, downloads, runs, and other long-running tasks and report their status and ETA when something changes, or on request. Tag a project with its categories in .project.toml and generate each host's per-project plugin enablement from it, so domain plugins such as research load only in the projects that use them. Put every web service a machine hosts behind one token-gated port with a landing page and a /<service>/ route each, and share single pages through scoped read-only guest tokens. Count who holds the shared behemoth GPUs and how busy they keep them, on a shareable niceness page. Chart the tokens and estimated cost of every model call the local coding agents make, like a stock, by agent, model or project.
